Tooltip_TLG_FuelSampleKit:
Used by Take a sample (kit), in the Fuel menu of a can or a tank.
A closer estimate, small amounts of water, and the blend.
Not used up.
Tooltip_TLG_FuelStabilizer:
Used by Add stabilizer, in a fuel can's Fuel menu.
The fuel ages more slowly. One bottle treats 20 L.
Tooltip_TLG_FuelFilter:
Used by Filter, in a fuel can's Fuel menu.
Takes out sediment and some free water. One use.
Tooltip_TLG_ManualFuelSystems:
How to start making ethanol, which engines take which fuel,
and what to do when a machine or engine stops.
Tooltip_TLG_BiodieselHandbook: Teaches how to build the five machines that make biodiesel.
Tooltip_TLG_WoodGasHandbook: Teaches how to build the Wood Gasifier.
Tooltip_TLG_YeastStarter: Starts a mash fermenting in place of yeast.
Tooltip_TLG_FermenterVessel:
Ferments a mash of sugar, water and yeast into wash.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_PotStill:
Distils wash into ethanol over a wood fire.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_RefluxStill:
Distils wash into stronger ethanol than a Pot Still gives.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_DryingColumn:
Dries ethanol with quicklime.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_WoodRetort:
Distils wood into methanol and charcoal over a wood fire.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_AshBarrel:
Burns wood to ash for the Lye Leacher.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_LyeLeacher:
Leaches wood ash with water into lye.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_BiodieselReactor:
Reacts plant oil with methanol and lye into crude biodiesel.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_BiodieselWashTank:
Washes and dries crude biodiesel, ready for a fuel can.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
Tooltip_TLG_DieselGenerator: Runs on diesel or biodiesel. Gasoline damages it.
Tooltip_TLG_Gasifier:
Turns wood into gas for a generator converted to gas,
within two tiles of it.
Put it on the ground and right-click it.
